text: What's a hill you'd die on that nobody here has ever heard you defend?
What's the smallest thing that can turn your whole day around?
If your life had a theme song right now, what is it, and why is it slightly embarrassing?
What's a compliment you got years ago that you still think about?
What's a weird skill you have that has never once been useful?
What did you want to be when you grew up, and how close did you get?
What's something you're proud of that you never get to brag about? Brag now.
What's a habit of yours you secretly hope someone finds charming?
When do you feel most like yourself?
What's something you've completely changed your mind about in the last year?
What was your honest first impression of the person to your left? Be kind. Be honest.
What's a fear you've outgrown, and one you're still carrying?
What's a moment with me you still replay that I've probably forgotten?
What kind of touch calms you down almost instantly?
What's something you need more of from me but feel silly asking for?
When was the last time you felt lonely while we were together?
What's a part of your body you've made peace with, and one you're still working on?
What's a kiss you still think about? No names. Just describe it.
What's something you've never told me because you were afraid of how I'd react?
What makes you feel wanted, not just loved?
What's something your past self would be shocked to see you doing now?
What's something you've wanted to try in bed but never said out loud?
What's something you've never forgiven me for, even a little?
What's the most turned on you've ever been with me, and what set it off?
Where's the riskiest place you've fantasized about having sex with me?
What's a fear about us you haven't said out loud yet?
What's a fantasy you'd never want to happen in real life, and why does it still work on you?
If you knew I'd say yes to anything tonight, what would you ask me to do to you?
What's a kink you're curious about but have never admitted to anyone?
What's your most persistent fantasy? Describe it slowly, in as much detail as you dare.
Tell the story of your most spectacular failed attempt to impress someone.
Finish this: "I'm weirdly, irrationally competitive about ____."
"My love languages are words of affirmation, quality time, and ____."
"If I were a snack, I'd be ____, because ____." Defend your answer.
Describe the best meal of your life: what it was, where, and who was across the table.
"The pettiest reason I've ever stopped liking someone was ____."
"The fastest way into my heart is ____. The fastest way out is ____."
Tell the story of a time you laughed so hard you had to leave the room.
Tell about a time you were braver than anyone gave you credit for.
Tell the person to your left about a moment you felt proud of them.
"The most attractive thing you did this week was ____." Explain yourself.
Confess something you've pretended to like for their sake.
Tell them about a moment you fell a little harder for them and didn't say so.
"I feel sexiest when ____." Then tell them how to make it happen more.
Tell them about a time you felt jealous and never mentioned it.
Describe the exact moment you first wanted to kiss them. Set the scene.
Tell the story of your first kiss ever, narrated like a nature documentary.
"When I'm alone and thinking about you, I mostly think about ____."
Describe the last time you thought about having sex with them when you really shouldn't have.
Confess a time you were turned on at the worst possible moment.
Tell them something you've carried shame about that you're ready to set down.
"The sexiest thing you could whisper to me in public is ____." Now whisper it.
Tell them, step by step, exactly how you'd like tonight to end. Take your time.
Confess the dirtiest thought you've had about them today. Leave nothing out.
Describe the best sex you've ever had with them as if you're telling them a bedtime story.
Describe your partner's laugh to someone who's never heard it.
Guess what song is stuck in their head right now. Then ask.
Name one thing each person here did tonight that made you smile.
On three, everyone point to the person most likely to cry at a commercial.
Hold eye contact with your partner for 60 seconds without talking. Laughing is allowed.
Name three things you love about how the person to your left looks right now.
Guess, in one word, what your partner is feeling right now. Let them tell you how close you got.
Close your eyes and describe their hands in as much detail as you can.
On three, everyone hold up 1 to 5 fingers: how much energy do you have left tonight?
Describe someone here in three words. Everyone else guesses who.
Describe your partner out loud, slowly, starting at their eyes and working down to their collarbones.
Put your hand over their heart for one minute. Tell them what you felt.
Tell them what you see in their face when they look at you.
On three, everyone point to the room in your home where you'd most like to be kissed right now.
Sit knee to knee. Without talking, try to sync your breathing for two minutes.
Look your partner over and say, out loud, exactly what you'd undress first and why.
On three, everyone silently show 1 to 5 fingers: how badly do you want to be touched right now?
Close your eyes. Describe the last time they made you want them, down to what they were wearing.
Hold eye contact while they slowly undress. Narrate what you notice. No touching until they say so.
Everyone secretly write down the one thing you want most tonight. Reveal together and see who matches.
